name: Taira no Noritsune
source:
Taira no Noritsune is the son of Taira no Noritsune, a military commander of the Heike family. Boasting a military power that is said to be the best warlord of the Heike, he is especially famous as a spirit soldier who shoots a strong bow.

A brave, warlike, and lively type of person on the battlefield. In the route of a certain person, not only a brave figure but also a brave side as a samurai can be seen.
